tasks.label: Firmware: Configure+Build (Ninja)
args: cmake -S firmware -B build/firmware-gcc -G Ninja -DCMAKE_TOOLCHAIN_FILE:FILEPATH=${workspaceFolder}/firmware/cmake/toolchain-arm-none-eabi.cmake; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; ninja -C build/firmware-gcc

tasks.label: Firmware: Flash (OpenOCD, CMSIS-DAP)
args: transport select swd; adapter speed 500; init; reset halt; program build/firmware-gcc/app.elf verify reset exit
